001: I need to buy a gift for my sister.
What a great idea! What kind of things does she like?
We could look in that store on the corner.
Yes, let's go. It's better if you help me choose.
Of course, I love going shopping with you.
002: Can you tell me the price of this jacket?
Yes, of course. That jacket costs forty euros.
It seems a bit expensive for my budget.
We have other cheaper ones at the back of the store.
There are blue, black, and gray. Would you like to see one?
003: I'm looking for some comfortable shoes for walking.
For everyday use or for sports?
For walking around the city, not for sports at all.
Then I recommend these leather ones, they are very light.
Can I try them on in a size thirty-eight?
Of course, I'll bring them to you right away.
004: This shirt is a little big on me.
Do you want to try a smaller size?
Yes, please. Do you have it in size thirty-eight?
One moment, I'll go look for it in the back.
Thank you very much, you are very kind.
Here it is. I hope it fits you better.
005: Do you have this skirt in another color?
Let me see... Yes, we also have it in white.
I like the white one, but it gets dirty very quickly.
That's true, but it looks very elegant for the summer.
You're right. I'll take it in white then.
Good choice. I'll wrap it up for you as a gift.
006: How much does this leather bag cost?
This model is on sale, it costs twenty-five euros.
And is it discounted because of some defect?
No, it's just that we're having a sale this week.
Then I'll take it, it's a bargain.
Great. Do you need anything else?
007: Do you accept card or only cash?
We accept both, whichever you prefer.
I prefer to pay by card, if it's not too much trouble.
It's no trouble at all. Go ahead to the register.
Here is my card, thank you.
Perfect, everything is all set. Have a nice day!
008: I want to return these pants, they don't fit me.
Yes, here it is. I bought them on Monday.
Very well. Would you like a refund or to exchange them?
I'd prefer to exchange them for another size, if possible.
Of course, let me see if we have the size you need.
009: Can you recommend an electronics store around here?
Yes, there's a really good one at the mall.
And do they have good prices on headphones?
I think so, they have some pretty interesting deals.
Great, I'll go this afternoon to take a look.
If you want, I'll come with you. I also need a cable.
010: This scarf is beautiful, but I don't have enough money.
Don't worry, I can lend you a few euros.
Really? I don't want to cause you any trouble.
Not at all, it's just a loan between friends.
Thank you so much, I'll pay you back on Monday without fail.
No rush, really. Enjoy your purchase.
